boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UTampa rituals and recurring campus practices, from the new Spartan Shout to the famously unusual Minaret climbs.

cards.title: Answer the Spartan Shout
cards.subtitle: UTampa’s call-and-response chant
cards.notes: Listen for the campus call-and-response and join only when prompted at an official gathering; it was introduced in 2025 as a UTampa spirit tradition.
cards.short_summary: A student-developed chant intended to give UTampa a shared voice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minaret reported that UTampa unveiled the Spartan Shout in 2025 as a new campus tradition developed to build school spirit.
cards.source_title: UTampa Introduces a Chant and Hand Signal to Strengthen School Spirit
cards.access_notes: Presented at campus gatherings; follow event hosts for when the chant is used.

cards.title: Put Your Shields Up
cards.subtitle: UTampa’s hand signal
cards.notes: Learn the hand signal from official campus demonstrations and use it alongside the Spartan Shout at appropriate school-spirit events.
cards.short_summary: The companion gesture to UTampa’s newly introduced chant.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minaret documented “Shields Up” as the hand signal introduced with the Spartan Shout in 2025.
cards.source_title: UTampa Introduces a Chant and Hand Signal to Strengthen School Spirit
cards.access_notes: The cheer squad and mascot have demonstrated it around campus; no special access is stated.

cards.title: The Senior Minaret Climb
cards.subtitle: Plant Hall’s graduation-season ritual
cards.notes: Treat this as a symbolic, University-managed senior activity—never attempt independent access to a minaret or any restricted Plant Hall area.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-season climb offering seniors a view from Plant Hall’s iconic minarets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minaret described Minaret Climbs as a Senior Week tradition in which seniors ascend an iconic Plant Hall minaret.
cards.source_title: UTampa Cancels Remaining Senior Minaret Climbs Due to Structural Concerns
cards.access_notes: The remaining 2025 climbs were canceled for structural-safety concerns; participate only if UTampa formally resumes and schedules them.

cards.title: Climb a Minaret at Alumni Weekend
cards.subtitle: A separate alumni-weekend offering
cards.notes: If the University schedules this experience again, reserve through its official alumni programming and follow all access and safety instructions.
cards.short_summary: The minaret tradition also appears in alumni programming, distinct from Senior Week.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minaret reported that a Minaret Climb is offered during Alumni Weekend in the fall, contingent on the relevant access conditions.
cards.source_title: UTampa Cancels Remaining Senior Minaret Climbs Due to Structural Concerns
cards.access_notes: The 2025 report made this contingent on repairs; confirm directly with UTampa before planning around it.

cards.title: Become a Virtual Minaret Climber
cards.subtitle: Give Day’s fundraising-climber tradition
cards.notes: For the annual Give Day, support a registered climber or consider the role only through the University’s official fundraising instructions.
cards.short_summary: A philanthropic twist on UTampa’s minaret imagery during its annual Give Day.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s alumni journal says Give Day traditions include donors who commit to be virtual Minaret climbers and raise funds for the University.
cards.source_title: Appreciation All Around for UT’s Give Day
cards.access_notes: Participation involves fundraising commitments described by UTampa; check the current Give Day page for eligibility and requirements.

cards.title: Go #AllinforUTampa
cards.subtitle: The University’s annual day of giving
cards.notes: Follow the University’s current Give Day schedule, share approved spirit materials, or attend a listed public campus activity without assuming a donation is required.
cards.short_summary: UTampa’s recurring 24-hour giving and community-engagement event.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa identifies #AllinforUTampa as its annual Give Day, a 24-hour experience for Spartans worldwide to show spirit and support the University.
cards.access_notes: Event dates and activities change; use UTampa’s Give Day page for the current schedule.

cards.title: Browse the Minaret Market
cards.subtitle: Give Day activity on the Sykes lawn
cards.notes: When it appears on the official Give Day schedule, stop by the Sykes College of Business lawn and confirm on-site details before participating.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering incorporated into UTampa Give Day programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s alumni journal lists the Minaret Market on the Sykes College of Business lawn among Give Day activities.
cards.source_title: Appreciation All Around for UT’s Give Day
cards.access_notes: Listed as a Give Day activity; consult the current official schedule for date, access, and any vendor details.

cards.title: Walk or Run the Give Day 5K
cards.subtitle: Plant Park to Pepin Stadium
cards.notes: Use the official registration and route information when announced; choose the walk option or pace that fits your comfort and follow event staff guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named fun run/walk included in UTampa’s Give Day schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s Give Day page lists a “UTampa Give Day 5K Fun Run/Walk” beginning at Plant Park and finishing at Pepin Stadium.
cards.access_notes: The page lists this in the Give Day event schedule; confirm the next occurrence, registration, and route with UTampa.

cards.title: Gather for Minarets at Sunset
cards.subtitle: Give Day’s named closing gathering
cards.notes: Look for the University’s current listing, then attend through the posted campus instructions and use the occasion to close out Give Day with the community.
cards.short_summary: A named closing-party activity connected to UTampa’s Give Day.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s alumni journal identifies Minarets at Sunset, held on the Southard Family Building patio, as the Give Day closing party.
cards.source_title: Appreciation All Around for UT’s Give Day
cards.access_notes: Programming is schedule-dependent; verify the current official Give Day listing before attending.

cards.title: Bring Bessie Her Red Roses
cards.subtitle: A Falk Theatre production custom
cards.notes: If you perform in a Falk Theatre production, ask the production team about the custom and follow its direction rather than entering attic spaces yourself.
cards.short_summary: A theater-department custom involving a dozen red roses for “Bessie.”
cards.evidence_claim: The Minaret reported a theater-department tradition in which a production’s leading or romantic lead brings Bessie a dozen red roses to the attic.
cards.access_notes: This is a department-specific production custom; access to backstage or attic areas must be arranged by authorized theater staff.
